negative_inactive_trio.current_error: attempts[6].agent_usage[1].provider_calls requires a positive-input call for a completed trio

negative_undercap_trio.previous_false_green: Independent audit reproduced complete declared coverage and zero violations before the correction.

positive_boundaries: A terminal solo call with one input token, all cached, and zero output remains valid as a measurement boundary.
A documented external_failure may contain zero measured use or no calls, including for a planned trio.

A trio truncated after its leader reaches exactly 80000 measured tokens may have inactive other agents; the synthetic matrix remains declared complete with zero receipt violations and criterion_4 not_assessed.
Exact exhaustion of the 5400-second active-time cap or the scheduled tool-call cap also permits a declared truncated attempt without a truncation-without-limit violation.

independent_review: A read-only reviewer reproduced all-zero completed calls, inactive completed trios, and under-cap truncated trios as three successive false greens. After the corrections the reviewer replayed the full 162-trio under-cap mutation and observed exactly 162 truncation_without_exhausted_limit violations with incomplete declared coverage; a cap-truncated trio remained valid. No remaining false green was found within this declared cap/trio boundary.
limits: Every token, agent ID, request ID, role and artifact is supplied in an unsealed local declaration; the auditor does not authenticate provider usage or agent identity.
One positive-input call per agent in a completed trio proves only structural participation, not independent specialist or reviewer work.

A truncated run remains an observed outcome under the predeclared design and is not replaced merely because some planned agents did not start, but requires a declared cap reached to count toward complete receipt coverage.
An early protective stop below all caps cannot be certified as an exhausted limit by schema 1; the receipt remains visible with a violation until a richer externally supported stop record is defined.
No confirmatory N/SDD/toolkit matrix, real model comparison, evaluation, cost or field outcome was executed.
